title: Flappy Bread Cat: One Loaf, Zero Aerodynamics
story: You are the Bread Cat: a cat loafed so hard someone dusted you with flour. Loaves are not built to fly, so every flap is a violent hop past baguettes and rolling pins before the bakery oven gets you.
inspiration: Bread Cat GIF (cat curled into a loaf, hands dusting it with flour) posted by @hardestgifs on X on 2026-11-16, ~11.5M views by 2026-11-18 and spreading as a WhatsApp sticker (MemeStand #1 on 2026-11-18). Archetype: Brick — gravity 0.95, jump 13.5 (apex ~96), because a loaf of bread should not fly. Bird: Wikimedia Commons 'Cute cat in loaf position' cut out with true alpha, warmed to crust tones and flour-dusted on top. Pillars: crossed baguettes (Commons 'Baguettes - stonesoup', flipped so tips face the gap) alternating with a rolling pin (pillar2). Sky: real bakery oven + bread racks photo with an animated falling-flour GIF loop. Rolling 7-day: adds a Brick extreme day, a pillar2 day and a GIF day after Moon/Hover/Twitchy/Afterburner/Gauntlet.
